vancouver-british-columbia-mount-baker-c.story: A rider’s loop: clean exit, memorable middle, calm return. 261 km round from Richmond - plan on about 4 h 45 of riding. It goes by way of West End, Scenic stretch near Lions Bay, near Squamish and Aldergrove. The climbs: Richmond and Near Aldergrove, on the way back. It tops out at about 1,200 m. It crosses from Canada into United States - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules.
